scope: Read-only startup diagnosis; anonymous observations and public plugin behaviour only.

claims: The supplied observations establish unmet startup prerequisites for this installed chat plugin; they do not establish a problem with the user's Markdown notes.
The hard-coded Unix-style executable search path is a Windows compatibility concern, not evidence that installing Docker alone will fix every failure.

evidence.text: Installed plugin brAIn version1.0.3. docker.exe is unavailable through command lookup; its standard Windows installation path is absent; no Docker Desktop/backend process is running. No listener on localhost port9000. Plugin settings file is absent; code defaults the API key to empty. No secret values were collected. Exact Obsidian error text was not captured.

The plugin README lists Docker as a requirement and asks users to configure their OpenAI API key, ingest vault documents, then open the chat. Installed code calls docker --version and starts a Docker-hosted web service before polling localhost:9000. Its child-process environment sets PATH to /usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin, and the plugin catches startup errors then shows a generic server-not-running notice.
